berserkers_fury: Critical basic hits deal 30% more hit damage and a delayed true-damage proc equal to 12% of the original hit.
blade_of_despair: Deal 25% more hit damage against enemy champions below 50% HP. TFM2 adaptation of Despair.
blade_of_the_heptaseas: After 5 seconds without dealing or taking champion combat damage, the next basic hit adds 56 + 40% total Attack physical damage and a 40% slow for 1.5 seconds.
corrosion_scythe: Basic hits queue 28 physical attack-effect damage and stack a target-local 8% slow up to 40% for 1.5 seconds (half strength for ranged carriers). Eligible Golden Staff repeats contribute attack effects and stacks. Shared Impulse grants 6% Attack Speed per stack, up to 30%, for 3 seconds; stronger finished Impulse supersedes Swift Crossbow.
demon_hunter_sword: Basic hits add physical damage equal to 8% current target HP, capped at 60 against non-champions. Heal 10 + 4 per level per basic hit, halved against non-champions.
endless_battle: A detected Skill 1, Skill 2 or Ultimate cooldown start arms the next basic hit for 3 seconds. It queues 60% total Attack true damage and heals 28 + 40% total Attack. Cooldown: 1.5 seconds. Cooldown transitions approximate cast events.
golden_staff: Converts observed initial non-equipment crit plus current catalog equipment crit to Attack Speed and suppresses crit. Every third non-critical basic hit repeats eligible DHS/Corrosion/Crossbow/Feather attack effects twice and grants 80% Attack Speed for 0.5 seconds. It does not triple the original attack. TFM2 limits: same-tick/target hits share an event; later non-equipment crit changes, hero skill attack-effect inheritance and attack-speed-cap overrides are not fully modeled.
great_dragon_spear: An Ultimate cooldown start grants 30% Movement Speed for 7.5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
haas_claws: Critical basic hits grant 20% Attack Speed for 2 seconds. Basic hits heal for 12% of actual enemy HP lost (15% Mythical), excluding structures.
hunter_strike: Five hits on the same champion or monster grant 50% Movement Speed decaying to zero over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Ordinary lane minions and towers do not qualify.
malefic_gun:
Armor Buster: Grants 30% Physical Penetration. Does not stack with Malefic Roar’s Armor Buster.
Grants 12% of listed base attack range as bonus range. Basic attacks grant 10% Movement Speed for 0.5s.
malefic_roar: Native penetration policy: shared Armor Buster grants 30% Physical Penetration once across Malefic Roar and Malefic Gun; Roar adds target Armor / 10, capped at 30%, for that hit. No lingering target-derived penetration buff.
rose_gold_meteor:
Grants Armor and Magic Resist equal to 25% of Attack, up to 35 each.
Lifeline: Taking damage while below 30% HP grants a 42 × level shield and 25% Movement Speed for 3s. Cooldown: 60s. Replaces Magic Blade’s Lifeline.
Lifesteal: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic hits.
sea_halberd: Damage applies shared Lifebane: 40% less healing and newly gained shields for 3 seconds. Existing shield layers are preserved. Deal 8% more hit damage against targets with higher total maximum HP; total HP remains the TFM2 substitute for bonus HP.
war_axe:
Fighting Spirit: Dealing damage grants 4 Attack for 4s, stacking up to 6 times. Stacks up to once per second. At full stacks, deals an extra 10% damage as true damage.
Hybrid Lifesteal: Restore 8% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic and skill hits.
wind_of_nature:
Wind Chant: Taking damage while below 30% HP automatically grants physical damage immunity for 2s for Marksmen, or 1s for other classes. Cooldown: 90s.
Lifesteal: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic hits.
windtalker: Basic hits trigger magic damage on up to 3 enemies within 60 range of the target: 50 + 5 per level. Cooldown: 4 seconds, reduced by 0.2 seconds per basic hit. Targets are selected by engine entity order.
blood_wings: Guard owns one persistent shield layer: 280 + total Magic Power (Mythical 350 + 125% Magic Power), raised/cut once by recipient shield modifiers. Only damage to this layer restarts its 20-second refill timer. Partial shields refill after that quiet interval; undamaged shields do not refresh periodically. Other shield layers are untouched. Grant 10% Movement Speed while Guard remains, or 50% for one second after its break. Unequipping/death removes only the owned layer and speed. Requires the verified 0.7.2 SDK-shield hook and shield-vector layout; duration-tag identity lasts over two simulated years.
clock_of_destiny: Magic champion hits gain timed defensive stacks, at most once per 0.4 seconds, up to 6 for 5 seconds. Each stack grants 4.5 + 0.5 per level Armor and Magic Resist. Shared Gift: below half HP, restore 15% max HP over 3 seconds, once per 60 seconds. Clock supersedes Elegant Gem; no mana effect.
concentrated_energy: Magic damage gains +3 Magic Power per timed stack, at most once per 0.4 seconds, up to 6 for 5 seconds. At full stacks every eligible magic hit deals 12% more damage; the stack acquisition interval does not gate the damage bonus. Basic hits and skill hits heal for 12% of actual enemy HP lost (15% Mythical), excluding structures and damage tagged as periodic or item damage.
divine_glaive: Native penetration policy applies 40% Magic Penetration plus target Magic Resist / 10, capped at another 20%, to that hit. Flat magic penetration is separate and applied after percentage penetration.
enchanted_talisman: TFM2 mana substitution: +5 additional Ability Haste in the stat block. TFM2 has no mana regeneration or mana capacity.
feather_of_heaven:
Affliction: Basic attacks deal 18 + 30% Magic Power bonus magic damage.
Impulse: Basic attacks grant 6% Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 5 times. Replaces Swift Crossbow’s Impulse.
Lifesteal: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic hits.
flask_of_the_oasis: Grants 12% outgoing heal/shield power on attributed native casts. An actual ally heal or attributed native shield starts a 3-second Blessing window. Below 35% HP during the window, grant a 35-per-caster-level shield for 3 seconds and reduce caster Skill 1/2 cooldowns by 2 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds per recipient. Direct SDK shields lack caster attribution: they receive incoming Oracle/Lifebane, but cannot independently start Blessing or receive outgoing power.
genius_wand: Magic champion damage applies target-local Magic Resist reduction stacks: 2 + level / 3 per stack, up to 3 for 2 seconds. Flat magic penetration is applied separately by the native policy.
glowing_wand: Damage applies shared Lifebane: 40% less healing and newly gained shields for 3 seconds. Non-item magic hits additionally burn for 1% target max HP per second for 3 seconds. Burn damage can refresh Lifebane and interact with defensive magic passives without restarting its own burn indefinitely.
holy_crystal: Gain 21% to 35% additional Magic Power, scaling from carrier level 1 to 15.
ice_queen_wand:
Ice Bound: Skill hits on heroes slow by 10% for 2s, stacking up to 3 times. Gains a stack per target at most once every 0.4s.
Spell Vamp: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct skill hits.
lightning_truncheon: Every 6 seconds a skill hit echoes for 85 + 85% total Magic Power magic damage to enemies within 60 range of its target.
starlium_scythe:
Crisis: After an ability starts its cooldown, the next basic attack within 3s deals 30 + 60% Magic Power bonus true damage and slows by 15% for 1.5s. Cooldown: 1.5s. Shares its on-attack proc with Calamity Reaper.
Hybrid Lifesteal: Restore 8% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic and skill hits.
wishing_lantern: Each target accumulates eligible resolved magic-hit damage separately. Every 315 damage queues a magic proc equal to 8% current target HP. Multiple thresholds can proc from one hit (32 immediate enqueues maximum, excess retained). Each queued proc re-reads current HP; item procs cannot recursively accumulate themselves.
antique_cuirass: Skill damage applies shared, attacker-local Deter for 2 seconds: each stack reduces subsequent physical damage by 8%, up to 24%. It does not reduce Attack or magic damage. Stronger Deter supersedes Dreadnaught Armor. Native policy starts the reduction after the triggering simulation tick.
blade_armor: Basic attacks taken reflect physical damage equal to 30% + 0.2% per point of total Armor of the incoming damage and slow the attacker by 15% for 1 second. Also grants 15% basic-attack damage reduction in its stats.
brute_force_breastplate: Dealing eligible damage gains a timed stack once per second, up to 6 for 4 seconds. Each gives either +2 Attack or +3 Magic Power (chosen from current total offensive stats), and +2% Movement Speed. At full stacks gain 25% Tenacity. Bonus-stat adaptive selection remains a TFM2 approximation.
chastise_pauldron: Taking damage reduces the attacker to 80% of observed normal Attack Speed for 2 seconds, accounting for an existing copy of the same debuff. This models speed strength; MLBB attack-speed-cap changes are not implemented. Surviving below 30% HP restores 20% max HP over 2 seconds, once per 60 seconds.
cursed_helmet: Every half second burn enemies within 60 range for 0.6% carrier max HP magic damage and reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by 6 for 3 seconds. No special minion multiplier.
dominance_ice: Nearby enemies receive shared Lifebane: 40% less healing and newly granted shields. Existing shield layers are not changed. Fortress grants 6 Armor/MR per nearby champion, capped at 30.
guardian_helmet: After 5 seconds without dealing champion damage or taking damage, recover 2.5% max HP per second. The native landing hook queues a heal for 30% + a calibrated max-HP term of resolved damage above 175; healing occurs next tick only if alive. A lethal hit remains lethal. This is a healing refund, not immunity.
immortality: While ready, a native landing record confirms lethal damage after shield absorption and typed protection; merely reaching 1 HP is insufficient. The one-time lethal rescue then banishes for 2.5 seconds and returns at 16% max HP with a 50 + 25-per-level shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 210 seconds, shared across copies, upgrade and rebuy; a pending recovery transfers to the new owner. Requires the landing hook; unavailable tracking disables the guard. This is guarded recovery, not true death/kill credit.
oracle: Native recipient policy raises incoming healing and new shields by 25%, including direct SDK shields, regeneration and vamp. Lifebane reduces the new shield once; existing shields are preserved. No fake flat regeneration bonus.
queens_wings:
Defiance: Grants up to 15% Attack and Magic Power as the holder’s HP falls.
Demonize: Taking damage while below 40% HP grants 30% damage reduction for 3s and reduces the holder’s skill cooldowns by 2s. Cooldown: 60s.
Spell Vamp: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct skill hits.
radiant_armor: Taking magic damage, including item damage, gains timed Magic Resist stacks: 3 + level / 2 per stack, up to 6 for 5 seconds, at most one per 0.4 seconds. Expired stacks restart at one. Flat resistance is the calibrated TFM2 rule; Radiant Armor is unrelated to the Mythical tier name.
thunder_belt: Every 4 seconds, a basic hit adds 18 + 35% total Armor and Magic Resist true damage and a 90% slow for 0.3 seconds. Champion procs permanently grant +1 Armor and Magic Resist. TFM2 adaptation hits one target and scales from total defenses.
twilight_armor: Surviving a hit over 175 damage refunds 20% + 0.02% per max HP of its excess, capped at 80%, as a heal. Surviving damage below 30% HP also instantly heals 20% max HP once per 60 seconds. Refunds cannot prevent death.
valkyries_shield: Athena/Valkyrie alias: the first magic hit starts a 3-second window with 25% magic damage reduction, including that first hit. Rearms after 5 seconds without a magic hit. Uses the verified native landing hook, rather than a delayed Magic Resist buff.
fleeting_time: Champion kills and assists reduce the remaining Ultimate cooldown by 30%.
sky_piercer: After a hit, execute champions at or below 4% HP with a delayed true-damage proc. Champion kills add 10 stacks, capped at 80; each raises the threshold by 0.1%. Lose 30% stacks on death. Stacks survive Mythical upgrade.
winter_crown: Automatic active: while alive and targetable below 30% HP, enter untargetable, damage-immune stasis for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 100 seconds. No manual item button.
demon_shoes: TFM2 mana substitution: champion kills reduce remaining Skill 1/2 cooldowns by 20%. No mana effect.
rapid_boots: Gain another 10% Movement Speed after 5 seconds without dealing or taking damage. Slow reduction is represented as general Tenacity in the stat block.
warrior_boots: Taking basic attacks stacks +3 Armor up to +15. Refreshed while in combat; counter resets after 5 seconds out of combat.
elegant_gem: Shared Gift: below half HP, restore 15% max HP over 3 seconds, once per 60 seconds. Clock of Destiny supersedes this component effect. No mana effect.
magic_necklace: TFM2 mana substitution: 3 Ability Haste instead of mana regeneration.
magic_blade:
Lifeline: Taking damage while below 30% HP grants a 21 × level shield and 25% Movement Speed for 3s. Cooldown: 60s. Does not stack with Rose Gold Meteor’s Lifeline.
Lifesteal: Restore 10% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic hits.
swift_crossbow: Basic hits queue 14 adaptive attack-effect damage (magic if current total Magic Power exceeds Attack). Shared Impulse adds 3% Attack Speed per stack, up to 15% for 3 seconds. Finished Impulse supersedes the component; eligible Golden Staff effects repeat.
azure_blade: A detected Skill 1, Skill 2 or Ultimate cooldown start arms 18 true on-hit damage for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 1.5 seconds.
black_ice_shield: Every half second gain +3 Armor and Magic Resist per enemy champion within 42.6 range, capped at +15. Shares Fortress Shield identity with Dominance Ice, whose stronger effect takes precedence.
dreadnaught_armor: Skill damage applies shared, attacker-local Deter: 4% less subsequent physical damage per stack, up to 12%, for 2 seconds. Antique Cuirass supersedes it. Native policy starts after the triggering simulation tick.
molten_essence: Burn enemies within 60 range for 0.6% carrier max HP per second. No special minion multiplier.
tough_boots: Tenacity in the stat block represents the crowd-control-duration reduction.
power_crystal: TFM2 mana substitution: 3 Ability Haste instead of mana capacity.

Hunter: Deals 30% more damage to monsters. Jungle role only.
Greed: Monster kills grant 5 bonus gold. Hero kills and assists grant 10 bonus gold. TFM2 calibration; no EXP, mana, Retribution spell or minion-reward penalty. Mythical is the mod custom tier, not original MLBB.

Hunter: Deals 40% more damage to monsters. Jungle role only.
Greed: Monster kills grant 8 bonus gold and restore 4% maximum HP. Hero kills and assists grant 10 bonus gold.
Gorge: Monster kills grant 1.4 Attack per stack, rounded after stacking, up to 10 stacks. TFM2 calibration; no EXP, mana, Retribution spell or minion-reward penalty. Mythical is the mod custom tier, not original MLBB.

Greed: Monster kills grant 8 bonus gold and restore 4% maximum HP. Hero kills and assists grant 10 bonus gold.
Gorge: Monster kills grant 2.1 Armor and Magic Resist per stack, rounded after stacking, up to 10 stacks. TFM2 calibration; no EXP, mana, Retribution spell or minion-reward penalty. Mythical is the mod custom tier, not original MLBB.

legacy_windtalker:
Typhoon: Basic attacks splash magic damage equal to 50 + 5 per level to up to 3 enemies. Five basic attacks charge the next basic hit. Shares its cooldown with Windtalker.
Activate: Typhoon grants 10% Movement Speed for 1s.
bloodlust_axe: Skill hits heal for 12% of eligible enemy HP damage, excluding structures.
deadly_blade: Basic hits against champions apply shared Lifebane for 1.5 seconds, reducing healing and new shields by 40%.
calamity_reaper: Calamity: After casting a skill, the next basic attack within 3s deals 75% Magic Power as bonus true damage and grants 10% Movement Speed for 1s. Cooldown: 1.5s. Shares the proc with Starlium Scythe.
scarlet_phantom: Frenzy: Basic attack critical hits grant 30% Attack Speed and 5% Crit Chance for 2s. Shares Frenzy with Haas’ Claws.

ice_force: Frost Strike: A basic attack on a hero slows their movement by 25% and reduces their Attack Speed by 15% for 1.5s. Cooldown: 3s.
bloodthirsty_king: Bloodlust: A hero kill or assist restores 12% maximum HP over 3s. Cooldown: 10s.
